name: Aya Triada Kilisesi
source: Built for the Istanbul 3D map (Grok Bot, 4 Nov 2026) on the OSM outline w206855035 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Figures and sources: data_pipeline/ayatriada/README.md; unpublished heights pixel-measured from reference photos (yaklaşık). Present-day state; toy style. Shape references never used as textures.

anchor.what: model origin = central dome, ground level

rotation_meaning: compass bearing of the model +X axis (model is in map axes: +X east, +Z south)
ground: y = 0 (flat); the map adds terrain height at the anchor only

heights_m.arms: 4 lead barrel-vaulted arms with rounded gables to ≈15.6 m; 4 small corner domes (yaklaşık)
heights_m.drum_dome: square base 12.0-17.0 m, drum Ø≈11.2 m 17.0-23.0 m with 12 windows, dome crown ≈27.8 m, lantern + cross to ≈31 m (pixel-measured, yaklaşık) [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.bell_towers: 2 four-storey towers ≈4.8 m square to 23.5 m, small domes, crosses to ≈30 m (pixel-measured, yaklaşık) [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.front: west narthex: two tiers of 5 arches, pediment with rose window (shape from sources; sizes yaklaşık)

parts: 4 lead barrel-vaulted arms with rounded gables
square base + drum with 12 windows + lead dome + lantern and cross
west narthex with 2-tier 5-arch portico and rose window
2 four-storey bell towers with small domes
footprint_note: map metres; map buildings under it are dropped
